count.description:
Number of elements to return. If set to 0 or null, then will use {@link #frac} to
determine how many samples to return.

frac.description: Fraction of items to return. Only used if {@link #count} is set to 0 or null. Only supported by {@link Array}.

replace.description: Allow or disallow sampling of the same row more than once (whether to do sampling with replacement).

dist.description:
Distribution of the values generated. The default is a uniform distribution (all values equally likely).

Notes:
 - Not all methods will be supported by all collections, but {@link Array} supports them all.
 - #replace should generally be `true` for distributions other than `UNIFORM`.

normalMeanFrac.description:
When #dist is {@link SampleSpec.Dist.NORMAL}, this can be used to set the base index to a fraction of the size.
For example, `0.5` is the center.

normalSdFrac.description:
When #dist is {@link SampleSpec.Dist.NORMAL}, this can be used to set how many standard deviations out the ends
of the array are. For example, `3` means the end values will be chosen only when the random value is 3σ from the
mean.

exponentialWeight.description:
When #dist is {@link SampleSpec.Dist.EXPONENTIAL}, this can be used to set how much more likely an element is
than the next one in the list. This value must be strictly > 0 and should not be too large, especially if the
collection has many elements.

title: Specification for how to perform sampling.
name: SampleSpec
